From Stafford CH 650 PM 21 Jan
Alps Col <insertion>Cesnola</insertion> reports further from allcock
dated 12 M two of my <deletion>saddling</deletion> <insertion>scouting parties</insertion>
parties came back one from bristersburg
& the other from wently P
O the last one got information
that 3 hundred Stuarts Cavy crossed
the Rapp coming from Elk Run
I suppose these are those some
of them were seen last evening
by my patrols Signed Abbott lawrence
